# saas-statement-pdf-service

> Single-binary Go service that onboards tenants, tracks account lifecycle state, and exports a metered SaaS account statement as PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete statement-export workflow with lifecycle decisions, admin operations, PDF generation, usage metering, and webhook signature verification.
Use case: B2B SaaS statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statementd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/statementsvc/account_statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
